description: The pie chart represents the distribution of answer types for a set of mathematical problems. There are three categories shown: Open-Answer, True-False, and Multi-Choice. The Open-Answer category has the largest proportion, occupying 63.0% of the chart, which corresponds to 244 instances. The True-False category is the second most common, with 32.8% of the chart, equating to 127 instances. The smallest category is True-False, with 4.1% of the chart, representing 16 instances. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled inside the corresponding slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
